items.title: “The probability of AI destroying humanity by 2030 is 0%”: Jensen Huang says AI should be advanced as fast as possible, and that he fears poverty, not taxes
items.title_zh: "2030年AI毁灭人类的概率是0%"！黄仁勋：应尽可能快推进AI，我只怕穷，不怕税
items.summary: In a CBS News interview, Nvidia founder, president and chief executive Jensen Huang gave a clear-cut verdict on the core disputes in AI: the narrative that AI will end humanity is entirely wrong and irresponsible, and AI should be advanced as fast as possible; he personally does not fear higher taxes, only poverty.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达创始人、总裁兼首席执行官黄仁勋近日在接受CBS News专访时，对当前AI领域最核心的争议给出了旗帜鲜明的判断：AI终结人类的叙事完全错误、不负责任，应以尽可能快的速度推进AI；他本人不惧加税，只怕贫穷

items.title: Jensen Huang says he does not fear paying tax, with his tax burden possibly reaching about 8 billion dollars over the next five years
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋称不惧纳税，未来五年税负或达约80亿美元
items.summary: This autumn, voters in Huang's home state of California will vote on a billionaire tax proposal that would levy a one-off 5% tax on California residents with net assets above 1 billion dollars.
items.summary_zh: 今年秋季，黄仁勋所在的美国加利福尼亚州选民将就一项亿万富翁税提案进行投票，该提案拟对净资产超过10亿美元的加州居民一次性征收5%的税

items.title: SpaceX looks ahead to Terafab: a million wafers a month to support 1 TW of compute
items.title_zh: SpaceX展望Terafab：月产100万片晶圆，支撑1TW算力
items.summary: SpaceX chief financial officer Bret Johnsen argues that because the expansion capacity of the existing global semiconductor supply chain, especially memory chips, falls far short of the triple-digit explosive growth demanded by orbital AI and the Starship programme, SpaceX must drive the Terafab project itself to break the supply bottleneck, aiming to reach substantive capacity before 2028 to 2029 and provide critical support for the inflection point in orbital AI compute.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX首席财务官Bret Johnsen认为，由于全球现有半导体供应链（尤其是存储芯片）的产能扩张速度远无法满足未来“轨道AI”和星舰项目三位数的爆发式增长需求，SpaceX必须亲自推动Terafab项目以突破供应链瓶颈，力争在2028年至2029年前形成实质性产能，为轨道AI算力的增长拐点提供关键支撑

items.title: The debt black hole behind the AI surge: as much as 1.2 trillion dollars of external financing may be needed over the next five years
items.title_zh: AI狂飙背后的“债务黑洞”：未来5年或需1.2万亿美元外部融资
items.summary: Global AI infrastructure build-out is burning capital at an unprecedented pace, but the debt engine supporting this supercycle has quietly swollen to a scale that has put the market on alert.
items.summary_zh: 全球AI基础设施建设正以史无前例的速度燃烧资本，但支撑这场"超级周期"的债务引擎已悄然膨胀至令市场警觉的规模
